versions.changelog:
Initial release of video-lesson-maker skill.

- Automates the process of transforming a document into multiple educational or science videos featuring whiteboard hand-drawing animation, TTS narration, and synchronized burnt-in subtitles.
- Supports theme extraction, hand-drawn illustration processing, animation rendering, TTS-based voiceover (with precise timing), and subtitle generation and burning.
- Includes a detailed 10-step workflow and comprehensive script/toolset for each stage of video production.
- Provides strict guidelines for annotation timing, script preparation, and subtitle formatting to avoid common production pitfalls.
- Designed for batch processing of teaching/courseware materials.
